name: NYCHA Citywide Special Events
description: This dataset lists special events held at New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) locations across the city. Each of the 368 sampled rows records an event's title, its location, its start time, and its recurrence pattern, indicating whether the event repeats and how often. The data covers community-oriented programming such as gatherings, activities, and seasonal events hosted at NYCHA sites. It can be used to explore the types and timing of events offered at public housing locations, identify which sites host the most activity, analyze scheduling patterns by day or time, and support residents, community organizers, or researchers looking for recreational programming in these neighborhoods.
